description: Connect your LightSite AI account to understand how AI assistants interact with your website. Review recorded AI crawler activity, AI-referred visits and conversions, tracked-prompt visibility, page diagnostics, and content and authority opportunities. Compare periods and turn the available evidence into clear next steps. Missing audit data is identified as unknown, and unverified brand-mention candidates are distinguished from verified coverage. When you agree to a specific action, ChatGPT can create a pending proposal for approval inside LightSite and check its status. Pending proposals can also be withdrawn. Work runs through LightSite only after approval there. A LightSite account with access to website data is required.

defaultPrompt: How is my website performing in AI search over the last 30 days?
Which pages do AI crawlers read without sending visitors?
Compare my AI traffic and conversions with the previous month.
